# kr8tiv AI

> kr8tiv AI is an AI consulting company in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. We help small businesses into the AI age: we work out what can be automated, build custom software so companies can retire old apps, connect and select the right tools, build company brains, and train teams and individuals, with corporate training systems, fractional CTO work and full business overhauls for bigger engagements. Fixed-price engagements; the source code for everything we build for a client is handed over to that client. Founder: Matt Haynes.

Last updated: 25 November 2026. This file is a plain-language guide for AI assistants and search tools. The linked pages are the source of truth.

Based in Edmonton, Alberta. Serves Edmonton, Sherwood Park, St. Albert and Spruce Grove, and businesses across Alberta and Canada remotely.

## What we build

- AI Ops Audit: one week inside an operation, mapping where the hours go; deliverable is a written automation plan the client keeps either way.
- Back-Office Build: agents wired into the client's existing stack. Automated receipt filing (photo to logged expense), quoting engines with break-even checks, dispatch from lead to invoice, morning digests, and watchdog agents that flag unpaid invoices and unscheduled deposits.
- AI Support Plan: ongoing monitoring, fixes, tool updates and small changes, month to month. No lock-in: the client owns the data, the documents, and the source code we wrote for them.

## One thing we built: Evolve

Evolve is a business app kr8tiv AI built for Evolve Eco Blasting, and the proof behind the Custom Business App service. Four parts share one Google Sheet: a field app the crew uses on their phones, a workbook that holds jobs, quotes, customers and money, an AI brain that prices quotes, files receipts, runs dispatch and writes the morning report, and an owner dashboard. Anything that moves money waits for a person to approve it.

## Proof

- Case study: Evolve Eco Blasting (Edmonton industrial surface restoration, https://evolveecoblasting.com). One crew, zero office staff. kr8tiv AI built their complete operations layer on the spreadsheets and drive they already owned. Nothing was replaced. Full write-up: https://kr8tiv.ai/work/evolve/
